content.title: Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 Friday livestream: How to watch Anyma and Sabrina Carpenter - Los Angeles Times
content.text: Updated April 16 for Coachella Weekend 2. The biggest change from Friday Weekend 1 will be Anyma’s midnight set on the main stage after Carpenter’s performance. Anyma was set to debut his highly anticipated “Æden” show April 10, but was forced to cancel due to weather.But you won’t have to worry about weather if you’re watching the “couchella” livestream. Sabrina Carpenter and Anyma on the Main Stage, Dijon, Turnstile and Disclosure at the Outdoor Theatre, and Bini, Devo and Blood Orange at the Mojave Tent are just some of the sets you’ll be able to see from the comfort of your couch.You can also watch via Coachella’s livestream app on iOS and Android.Here are updated set times for Weekend 2’s Friday livestreams (times presented in PDT):Main Stage5:20 p.m. Teddy Swims; 7 p.m. The xx; 9 p.m. Sabrina Carpenter; 12 a.m. AnymaOutdoor Theatre4 p.m. Dabeulll; 5:20 p.m. Lykke Li; 6:40 p.m. Dijon; 8:05 p.m. Turnstile; 10:40 p.m. DisclosureSahara4 p.m. Youna; 4:50 p.m. Hugel; 6:15 p.m. Marlon Hoffstadt; 8 p.m. Katseye; 9:15 p.m. Levity; 10:50 p.m. Swae Lee; 12:05 a.m. Sexyy RedMojave4:15 p.m. Bini; 5:30 p.m. Central Cee; 6:45 p.m. Devo; 8:10 p.m. Moby; 9:20 p.m. Slayyyter; 10:45 p.m. Ethel Cain; 12 a.m. Blood OrangeGobi4 p.m. Bob Baker Marionettes; 4:45 p.m. NewDad; 5:30 p.m. Joyce Manor; 6:15 p.m. CMAT; 7:20 p.m. Fakemink; 8:25 p.m. Holly Humberstone; 9:50 p.m. Joost; 11:05 p.m. Creepy NutsYuma4 p.m. Groove Armada; 5 p.m. Rossi. x Chloe Caillet; 6:15 p.m. Kettama 7:30 p.m. Prospa; 8:45 p.m. Max Dean x Luke Dean; 10 p.m. Max Styler; 11:15 p.m. GordoQuasar5 p.m. Darco; 7 p.m. Franky Rizardo; 9 p.m. Armin van Buren x Adam Beyer; 11 p.m. Kettama x Prospa x Josh BakerNote that there have been livestream delays in past years, so don’t worry if your favorite artist is a few minutes late.
